about: Cupcake avatar requested 2026-10-17 to replace the sprinkle muffin: plain cupcake, whipped frosting, a cherry on top, sprinkles. The app keeps the muffin's falling-sprinkle physics and adds the face, so the model is faceless and plain. Same rules as demo-avatars-01..04: no Tripo rig, no brands or text.
style: Fun, charming cartoon style like a polished stylized 3D game asset: smooth chunky shapes, bold readable silhouette, appealing saturated colours.

props.subject: a single plain cupcake standing upright: a pleated pastel-mint paper liner as the base, a soft golden vanilla cake just above the liner, a big tall swirl of fluffy white whipped-cream frosting piled on top in smooth rounded swirls, one shiny red cherry with a short green stem sitting on the very top of the swirl, lots of tiny colourful sugar sprinkles scattered over the frosting; plain and simple, no face, no decorations other than the sprinkles and the cherry, standing directly on nothing (no plate, no stand, no platform, no base under the liner)
